agent_explanation: Single body in free fall (no walls, controller disabled, work 0) gains energy every step. vy grows by ~1.26 per dt=0.02138 step while g*dt=0.21, i.e. effective gravity ~6x too large; positions confirm the over-large fall. Semi-implicit Euler with fast-body substepping (41-43 substeps/step reported) is over-applying gravity per step, injecting spurious kinetic energy faster than potential loss, so total energy climbs ~43 J/step until it breaches the 10%+5J bound at step 4. Small-dt rerun conserves energy.
